title: Slushie Bar Salts Sour Skizzles 10ml E-Liquid
description: Sour Skittlez in the Slushie Bar Salts collection is a deliciously edgy e-liquid that perfectly captures the tangy and sweet taste of the popular rainbow candy. This flavour is a playful tango of sour and sweet notes, creating a lively and enjoyable vaping experience. Each inhale brings a burst of sour tang, reminiscent of the initial bite into a sour candy, which is quickly followed by a wave of sugary sweetness, balancing the sharpness with a sugary embrace. This e-liquid is like a fun and unpredictable candy bag; each draw brings a new layer of flavour, keeping your vaping experience exciting and varied. The blend of tart and sweet elements makes Sour Skittlez a perfect all-day vape for those who enjoy a bit of zing in their e-liquid. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
